definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 splits 'character' into four senses (4.26 a code value of a coded character set, 4.27 a graphic character in a screen item, 4.28 a COBOL character, 4.29 a single code value in storage); 2023 drops those entries but keeps each sense under its own term (§2023:3.7 alphanumeric character, national character, §2023:3.93 graphic character, §2023:3.37 COBOL character repertoire), so the drop is of a heading, not of a meaning. The 'last character' of a screen input field is the screen-item sense (4.27, graphic character), which §2023:3.93 keeps as graphic character; the screen section is declined at both editions.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination) are flagged by the word 'termination': GR5 speaks of normal termination of the ACCEPT screen statement (§2002:13.16.3.2 GR5), not run unit termination or a transfer of control, so it rests on none of the three clauses; the screen section is declined at 2002 in any case.
